scope: Source archive packaging; no new numerical qualification or binary release

surviving_source_check.method: Every current_path matches current_sha256 in the frozen relocation review.
surviving_source_check.digest_encoding: Sorted UTF-8 relative path, NUL, ASCII SHA256, NUL per surviving input.
surviving_source_check.identity_boundary: Staging retired tracked paths changes the old worktree fingerprint; this content-only check does not relabel earlier scientific results.

method.method: Traverse final JSON file references and explicit local Markdown links from index930, maintenance freeze and its 138 maintained Markdown entries. Add README companions of selected result ancestors, not whole sibling logs/directories.
method.normalized-commands.txt: Explicitly referenced normalized compiler-command records retained up to 1MiB; identical copies deduplicate as Git blobs.
method.never_select: h5, executable/library/object, SQLite/Nsight, generic .dat including *_log.dat. Nothing is deleted locally.

existing_large_asset.policy: Unchanged inherited LFS pointer; no new table payload.

excluded_local_artifacts.policy: No generated HDF5, executables, object/static/shared libraries, dependency installations, profiler databases, generic runtime .dat logs or oversized raw traces. Local artifacts are retained and historical hashes/paths remain unmodified.

file_manifest_scope: All selected and inherited regular worktree files, except this self-describing JSON. SHA256 describes working-tree bytes; the existing Helmholtz table is represented by its LFS pointer in Git.
boundaries: This source checkout intentionally cannot reproduce a historical full artifact-identity audit without its excluded HDF5 files, binaries and large raw traces. Build/run fresh results for new validation; do not reinterpret omitted artifacts as numerical failures.
No old report, failed/deferred result, mathematical implementation, compiler flag, factory route or acceptance budget was changed for packaging.
Third-party pending confirmations remain as documented in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
